title: Traditional German Bratwurst Bowl
description: A hearty German dish featuring grilled bratwurst sausage, crispy potatoes, and a variety of toppings. Serve in a warm bowl for a comforting meal.
instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Grill the bratwurst sausage for 5-7 minutes on each side, or until browned and cooked through.
3. Meanwhile, peel the potatoes and cut them into wedges. Toss with butter, salt, and pepper.
4. Grill the potato wedges for 5-7 minutes on each side, or until crispy.
5. Slice the onion and grill for 2-3 minutes, or until softened.
6. Warm the bowl by filling it with hot water and letting it sit for a minute. Drain the water.
7. Assemble the dish by placing the grilled bratwurst, potatoes, and onion in the warm bowl.
8. Drizzle with mustard and serve with a side of German beer.
9. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
